claim_assertions.prior_tax_charge_exceeds_half_growth: The excluded prior tax charge exceeds half the FY2025 increase in GAAP net income.
claim_assertions.entire_net_growth_is_operating: The full annual GAAP net-income increase equals the operating-income increase.
claim_assertions.exact_product_price_effect_identified: The supplied category revenue and cost tables separately identify the exact product price effect.

definitions.category_margin: Both fiscal years, months=3 Q4 and 12 annual. Category gross margin uses category revenue.
definitions.net_income_growth_bridge: Six signed net-income components per duration. Expenses and tax enter negatively. Contributions divide by the same-duration GAAP net-income increase.
definitions.prior_tax_baseline: Remove the prior tax charge by adding it to prior net income. Current remains GAAP. Percentage growth uses each clearly declared baseline.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient facts and relevant period, unit, definition or scope context for each output. Additional unrelated sections fail evidence. Equivalent reviewed source paths are accepted, without a shortest-citation requirement.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
